Definition: from G1537 and G2045; to explore (figuratively):--search diligently.
BiblicalUsage: The word exereunáō carries the sense of to search diligently. In 1 Peter 1:10, the text says "Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently."
TheologicalSignificance: I take exereunáō as it stands: to search diligently.
